- Get SAML metadata -> owner: Raj -> due: 2026-04-05
- Dev cluster & redaction POC -> owner: Kelsey -> due: 2026-04-12
- Eval success criteria doc -> owner: Megan -> due: 2026-04-07
- Weekly check-ins post-deploy -> owner: Megan -> cadence: weekly

Oli (Sales): Uploading metadata + anonymized sample notes to shared drive and will intro IT contact.

Raj (Support): Acked. Will update CS-7022 with links when available.

Megan (CS): I'll schedule a 30-min sync with their IT after they run the Okta test.
